items.q: What do you need from me to start?
items.a: Architectural or structural drawings, design criteria (governing code, loads if available), and any existing models or site constraints. A short brief is enough to get a quote.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on tonnage and complexity. After reviewing your drawings I confirm a schedule before work starts, so you know delivery dates up front.

items.q: What file formats do you deliver?
items.a: PDF drawings and DWG/DXF by default. Tekla-based outputs such as IFC or NC files can be provided on request; tell me what your fabricator needs.
Clarifications and design changes are handled through the project, and the revision approach is agreed at the start so there are no surprises.

items.q: Which codes and standards do you work to?
items.a: I follow the code specified for your project, local or international. Tell me the governing standard and I will detail to it.

items.q: Can you work on existing buildings?
items.a: Yes. I prepare as-built drawings and retrofitting designs for existing RCC and steel structures, including site checks.
